violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food * was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food *. . Raw meat stored above sliced cheese.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. . Wiping clothes should be stored in sanitizer solution when not in use.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. . Vent hood and filters require immediate cleaning. Referral to state fire marshal.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling * were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. . Floor tiles in the kitchen broken and uncleanable.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floor and ceiling dirty.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Ice scoop was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing.
Toilet facilities. — --Woman's toilet room was not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) missing floor and ceiling tiles
Clean, maintained, tissue, vented, self-closing door (1 pt deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
